description: This file defines a minimal circuit breaker class for managing failure thresholds and open durations, used to prevent repeated failures in network or service calls.

classes.name: CircuitBreaker
classes.description: Implements a simple circuit breaker pattern that opens after a specified number of consecutive failures, temporarily blocking further attempts for a cooldown period.

classes.name: CircuitOpenException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when the circuit is open and a protected function cannot be executed.

methods.name: protect
methods.description: Executes a passed asynchronous function if the circuit is closed; otherwise, throws a CircuitOpenException. It tracks failures and opens the circuit after reaching the failure threshold.
